Be sure to run `renv::restore()`, and then click on the "Run Document" button.

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar
sliderInput(
  "mu", 
  "mu:", 
  min = 400, 
  max = 700, 
  value = 450
  )
sliderInput(
  "spcom",
  "Community Sigma",
  min = 50,
  max = 150,
  value = 80
)

sliderInput(
  "nspeak",
  "Number of speakers",
  min = 3,
  max = 10,
  value = 5
)

sliderInput(
  "ndata",
  "Data points per speaker",
  min = 10,
  max = 50,
  value = 20
)
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill
plotOutput(
  "distPlot",
  width = "400px",
  height = "250px"
)
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill

  "spDists", 
  width = "100%",

```

```{r}
#| context: server
library(tidyverse)
library(distributional)
library(ggdist)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 20))

theme_no_y <- function(){
  theme_sub_axis_y(
    text = element_blank(),
    title = element_blank()
  )
}

dist <- reactive({
  dist_normal(0,input$spcom)
})

dist_samp <- reactive({
  tibble(
    gamma = generate(dist_normal(0, 1), input$nspeak)
  ) |> 
    unnest(gamma) |> 
    mutate(
      speaker = factor(row_number())
    ) 
})
  
gammas <- reactive({  
  dist_samp() |> 
    mutate(
      gamma = gamma * input$spcom
    )
})

output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
  ggplot() + 
    stat_slab(
      aes(xdist = dist()),
      fill = NA,
      color = "black"
    ) + 
    xlim(-300, 300) +
    geom_dots(
      data = gammas(),
      aes(
        x = gamma,
        color = speaker,
        group = 1
      ),
      binwidth = 20,
      shape = "triangle"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Speaker offsets"
    ) +
    theme_no_y()
})

spDists <- reactive({
  gammas() |> 
    mutate(
      dist = dist_normal(input$mu + gamma, 180)
    )
})

spGamma <- reactive({
  gammas() |> 
    mutate(
      distg = dist_normal(gamma, 180)
    )
})

spBase <- reactive({
  tibble(
    speaker = as.factor(1:input$nspeak),
    mu1 = 0
  ) |> 
    mutate(
      sdist = dist_normal(mu1, 1),
      f1 = generate(sdist, input$ndata)
    ) |> 
    unnest(f1) |> 
    select(-sdist)
})

spData <- reactive({
  gammas() |> 
    left_join(
      spBase(),
      by = "speaker"
    ) |> 
    mutate(
      f1 = (f1 * 180) + input$mu + gamma
    )
  # |> 
  #   mutate(
  #     f1 = f1 + input$mu + gamma
  #   )
})


output$spDists <- renderPlot({
  spDists() |> 
    ggplot() +
      stat_slab(
        aes(
          xdist = dist,
          color = speaker
        ),
        fill = NA
      ) +
    xlim(0, 1200) +
    labs(x = "f1", title = "Speaker Distributions") +
    theme_no_y()
})

output$spDat <- renderPlot({
  spData() |>
    mutate(
      f1 = case_when(
        f1 < 0 ~ 0,
        f1 > 1200 ~ 1200,
        .default = f1
      )
    ) |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_dots(
      aes(
        x = f1,
        color = speaker,
        group = 1,
        order = speaker
      ),
      shape = "circle",
      binwidth = 15
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1200) +
    labs(
      title = "Observed Data"
    ) +
    theme_no_y()
})

```
